title: Transpose of a Cartesian square with its chosen pullback identification
statement: Let $X',X,Y',Y$ be schemes, let $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $f:X\to Y$, and $g:Y'\to Y$, and let $s$ be a Cartesian square with a chosen pullback identification [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Thus $g'f=f'g$ and the chosen isomorphism $e:X'\xrightarrow{\sim}X\times_Y Y'$ has projections $g'$ and $f'$. Define its transpose to be the square with first and second arrows $f',g'$ and lower arrows $g,f$, with commutativity the symmetry of the original commutativity equality, and with chosen identification $e$ followed by the canonical symmetry $X\times_Y Y'\xrightarrow{\sim}Y'\times_Y X$. Its first and second projections are respectively $f'$ and $g'$. This construction retains the chosen Cartesian data and assumes no morphism property.
